title: Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay Order Points on Mobile Wallet Wrong-Wallet Re-Credits
content:
Training Q&A on how **Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay** orders earn points on a **Mobile Wallet** re-credit after money went to the wrong wallet.

**Rule.** The Top-Up points of a wrong-wallet re-credit follow the customer's Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay orders with status delivered that were ordered in the last 6 calendar months:

| Delivered orders in the window | Top-Up points |
|---|---|
| 5 or more | 0.15 |
| at least 3 and fewer than 5 | 0.08 |
| fewer than 3 | nothing |

The window is rolling: it holds the orders whose order moment lies fewer than 6 whole calendar months before today, the whole calendar months from a date to today being the difference between the two calendar months, less one when today's day of the month is lower than that date's.

### Questions the rule answers
**Do orders that were not delivered count?** No; only orders whose status is delivered.

**Four delivered orders in the window?** At least 3 and fewer than 5: 0.08 points.

**Today is 2026-04-20; does an order placed on 2025-10-20 count?** No: that is 6 whole calendar months. One placed on 2025-10-21 gives 5 and counts.
